_fixture_doc.purpose: LIVE D-PROBE for the cardGroups.js:202 type-mismatch. A round-1 card is PLACED in submodules_per_step BY ITS UUID on submodule X (content-writer); a routing-only round-2 card targets the SAME submodule X. On QA citation:fail the round-2 instruction is written for X. The probe: does X execute EXACTLY ONCE at round 2, or TWICE (double-dispatch)?
_fixture_doc.the_defect_under_test: collectUnplacedDispatchGroups (cardGroups.js:202) skips a pending instruction when `placed.has(p.submodule_id)`. `placed` is the Set of raw submodules_per_step ENTRIES — here the round-1 card's UUID, NOT the string 'content-writer'. So placed.has('content-writer') is FALSE, and the round-2 instruction for X is treated as UNPLACED → dispatched by the WF-1 pass. Meanwhile the PLACED loop's expandCardGroups ALSO matches it (p.submodule_id === submoduleId at cardGroups.js:94) → a second dispatch. If both fire and nothing dedups at the row layer, X runs TWICE at round 2.
_fixture_doc.verdict_rule: Count entity_submodule_runs rows for content-writer at round 2 (loop_iteration 1) for the failing entity. TWO rows ⇒ live :202 defect CONFIRMED — capture both rows verbatim, STOP AND REPORT (Daniel decides the fix before any flip). ONE row ⇒ report WHICH mechanism deduped (checkExistingSubmoduleRun key? the card_id-inclusive unique index on entity_submodule_runs from the 2026-06-03 Multi-Card migration?) with evidence — 'worked by coincidence' vs 'worked by design' matters for the manifest.
